summary.text: Xavier Stevens is the Democratic candidate for the Vermont House of Representatives in the Orleans-2 District in the November 3, 2026 general election. An environmental engineer who grew up in the Northeast Kingdom, he says his priorities include affordability, health care, civil rights and environmental protection.

paragraphs.text: Xavier Stevens earned a high school diploma from St. Johnsbury Academy and a bachelor's degree from the University of Vermont in 2019.

According to Ballotpedia, his career experience includes working as an environmental engineer; in a Ballotpedia survey he said he holds a degree in mathematics and works to hold businesses accountable to Environmental Protection Agency regulations.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on August 11, 2026.
In the survey, Stevens listed five core tenets: affordability, health care, enshrining human and civil rights, environmental protection, and accountability and availability.
He said he supports universal health care, guarantees for education, and enshrining rights such as abortion access in the Vermont Constitution.
He listed endorsements from 3.14 Action, Linda Daybell and NEK North Indivisible.
